gen-gf-unica-one-gf-gafata: Commanding strokes of Unica One keep every curve wide open and every line uniform, a display voice with real nerve. Gafata is the quieter one, a plain sans with tall letters.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-geist: Clean and commanding, Unica One leads with a huge lowercase and lines of uniform thickness. Geist, a sans-serif, then runs level and unaccented, so paragraphs settle into solid, even blocks.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-gidole: Huge lowercase eyes with daylight inside every curve define Unica One, which is built for announcing. Gidole, a sans-serif with a high midline and open terminals, is built for carrying the quieter text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills its lines with a tall x-height and a widely parted s. Unica One is best at striking, uniform-stroke display lettering, while the plain sans body is best at approachable, steady text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Ruler-straight and loud. Unica One draws every stroke at constant width, and Hedvig Letters Sans, a sans-serif, adds friendly small letters standing almost as tall as its capitals, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-heebo: Heebo reads with a tall central band and curves that stop short of closing. Unica One is best at distinctive, stress-free display lettering, while Heebo is best at steady, professional running text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-guntur: Unica One leads, commanding and monoline. Hind Guntur, a sans with tall stamped-metal lowercase and wide gaps where curves meet stems, follows without any thick-thin shift, so the two feel cut from one cable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-madurai: Unica One has a very large lowercase eye and visible daylight inside every curve, all drawn at one thickness. Hind Madurai, a plain sans, offers a friendly counterpart whose letters fill the line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru reads tight and tall, its lowercase pressing toward the ascender height. Give that sans a comfortable size and let Unica One keep its commanding display scale.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-siliguri: Stark, uniform and confident. Unica One headlines with huge lowercase eyes, then Hind Siliguri, a sans-serif with gapped rounds and a flat gray hum, gives a friendly, steady counterweight that is the pair's strongest quality.
